input: one ASCII decimal uint32 value per line, at most 64 messages and 128 bytes per line
output: a canonical JSON final record containing identity-bound checkpoint state and a stable output digest

rules: C11 parsing must reject empty, nondecimal, oversized, and out-of-range frames
the Rust authority cannot bypass input, timeout, checkpoint, or replacement limits
restore requires exact system, binding, generator, input, and state identities
authority replacement is allowed only from rust-authority-v2 to go-readable-authority-v2 under the explicit replacement flag
partial, duplicate, misordered, mismatched, or version-incompatible process responses reject

determinism: For an identical canonical workload and accepted authority behavior, uninterrupted, recovered, and readable-replacement executions must emit the same output digest.
